scientific_integrity: The exact proof uses a published manifold-recognition theorem, explicit signed fundamental cycle, van Kampen for a graph of simply connected spaces, and classical 3-manifold classification. Finite code is only corroborating evidence. No independent mathematical audit has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Orientability holds for positive p,q, but the free-group calculation is restricted to p=1 and q>=2, and the connected-sum homeomorphism is established only for p=1,q=2. No higher-dimensional classification, diffeomorphism claim, or unordered quotient is proved. An unindexed prior argument cannot be excluded.
title: Orientability and a connected-sum classification of asymmetric simplex-skeleton deleted products
